input.quote: (b) Sparkling may terminate this Agreement at any time upon ninety (90) calendar days written notice to Garman. If Sparkling terminates this Agreement pursuant to this Section 17(b), Sparkling shall cease using the Software at the end of the ninety (90) day notice period, and shall certify to Garman within thirty (30) calendar days of termination that Sparkling has destroyed or has returned to Garman all Software, Documentation and Codes.
input.rationale: Section 17 (Term and Termination) deals only with our exit obligations (ceasing use and certifying return/destruction of Garman's Software, Documentation and Codes) and, on Garman's default, conversion to a perpetual licence plus refund of prepaid fees. There is no obligation anywhere on Garman to provide transition assistance, to return Sparkling data in a usable format, or to delete and certify deletion of our data. The only comparable provision, Section 8(b), applies solely if we exercise the Section 7 rejection option, and Section 18 survival lists no exit-assistance clause. Given Garman performs data conversion (Section 4 / Schedule "D") and holds our Confidential Information, the rule's expected clause is absent and falls short of even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus 30-day export). Proposed insert adopts the preferred position (six months' assistance at then-current rates, 30-day machine-readable return, deletion certification); 90 days' assistance is an acceptable fallback.

proposal.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, data return and deletion certification obligation in Section 17
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard exit clause requiring Garman to provide transition assistance for up to six months at its then-current rates, to return our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days and to certify deletion thereafter, since the Agreement currently imposes no data-return or migration obligations on Garman outside the Section 8 rejection scenario. We can work with 90 days of assistance if six months is difficult.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Garman shall (i) at Sparkling's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Garman's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) calendar days, return to Sparkling all of Sparkling's data and Confidential Information in Garman's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all such data and Confidential Information from its systems and certify such deletion to Sparkling in writing.
